body.id: Helen Keller tidak bisa melihat dan mendengar, tetapi ia belajar membaca, menulis, dan kuliah.
body.en: Helen Keller could not see or hear, yet she learned to read, write and go to university.

body.id: George Washington Carver lahir dalam perbudakan, lalu menjadi ilmuwan pertanian yang menolong petani.
body.en: George Washington Carver was born into slavery and became a farm scientist who helped farmers.

body.id: Keduanya menghadapi rintangan besar dengan tekun dan hati yang baik.
body.en: Both faced great obstacles with patience and a kind heart.

body.id: Wangari Maathai mengajak para ibu di Kenya menanam jutaan pohon.
body.en: Wangari Maathai got mothers in Kenya to plant millions of trees.

body.id: Nelson Mandela berjuang agar semua orang di Afrika Selatan setara, lalu memilih berdamai.
body.en: Nelson Mandela worked so that everyone in South Africa would be equal, then chose peace.
Both won the Nobel Peace Prize.

title.en: Helen Keller and her first word

ST-KELLER.source: American Foundation for the Blind, "Helen Keller: Life Chronology" (born 27 June 1880, Tuscumbia, Alabama; lost sight and hearing after an illness in 1882; Anne Sullivan began teaching 3 March 1887; W-A-T-E-R breakthrough 5 April 1887; Radcliffe, 1904, first deaf-blind person to earn a college degree; worked with AFB from 1924; visited 39 countries; died 1 June 1968); Keller, The Story of My Life (1903).

caption.id: Helen Keller lahir di Alabama, Amerika Serikat, tahun 1880. Saat masih bayi, ia sakit keras, lalu tidak bisa melihat dan mendengar.
caption.en: Helen Keller was born in Alabama, in the United States, in 1880. As a baby she fell very ill, and afterwards she could not see or hear.

caption.id: Helen kecil sulit memberi tahu apa yang ia inginkan. Ia sering sedih dan marah karena tidak ada yang mengerti.
caption.en: Little Helen found it hard to tell people what she wanted. She was often sad and upset because no one understood.

caption.id: Tahun 1887, guru Anne Sullivan datang dan mengeja kata-kata dengan jari di telapak tangan Helen. Di dekat pompa air, Helen akhirnya mengerti: a-i-r!
caption.en: In 1887 a teacher, Anne Sullivan, arrived and spelled words with her fingers into Helen's palm. By the water pump, Helen finally understood: w-a-t-e-r!

caption.id: Helen belajar membaca huruf Braille dan menulis. Tahun 1904, ia lulus dari universitas, orang tunanetra-tunarungu pertama yang berhasil melakukannya.
caption.en: Helen learned to read braille and to write. In 1904 she graduated from university, the first deaf-blind person ever to do so.

caption.id: Ia menulis buku dan mengunjungi 39 negara untuk membela hak orang tunanetra. Dari Helen, kita belajar pantang menyerah.
caption.en: She wrote books and visited 39 countries to speak up for blind people. From Helen we learn never to give up.

ST-CARVER.source: National Park Service, George Washington Carver National Monument, "George Washington Carver" (born enslaved about 1864 on the Moses and Susan Carver farm, Diamond, Missouri; 'The Plant Doctor'; refused by schools because of his race; Simpson College 1890; Iowa State 1891-1896; Tuskegee from 1896 for 47 years; crop rotation and soil care; more than 300 uses for the peanut; the Jesup Wagon travelling school); National Peanut Board, "Who invented peanut butter?" (Carver did not invent peanut butter).

caption.id: George Washington Carver lahir sekitar tahun 1864 di Missouri, Amerika Serikat. Ia lahir sebagai budak, dan perbudakan dihapus saat ia masih bayi.
caption.en: George Washington Carver was born around 1864 in Missouri, in the United States. He was born enslaved, and slavery was abolished while he was a baby.

caption.id: Ia sangat suka tanaman, dan tetangga membawa tanaman yang layu kepadanya karena ia tahu cara menyembuhkannya. Mereka menyebutnya "dokter tanaman".
caption.en: He loved plants, and neighbours brought him wilting plants because he knew how to heal them. They called him "the plant doctor".

caption.id: Banyak sekolah menolaknya karena warna kulitnya. Ia tidak menyerah dan terus mencari, sampai akhirnya ia kuliah pertanian di Iowa.
caption.en: Many schools turned him away because of the colour of his skin. He did not give up and kept looking, until at last he studied farming at a college in Iowa.

caption.id: Tahun 1896, ia menjadi guru di Tuskegee, Alabama. Ia mengajari petani menanam kacang tanah dan ubi bergantian dengan kapas supaya tanah tetap subur.
caption.en: In 1896 he became a teacher at Tuskegee, Alabama. He taught farmers to grow peanuts and sweet potatoes in turn with cotton, so the soil stayed rich.

caption.id: Di labnya, ia menemukan lebih dari 300 kegunaan kacang tanah: sabun, tinta, minyak, dan lainnya. Ia juga berkeliling dengan gerobak sekolah untuk mengajar petani.
caption.en: In his lab he found more than 300 uses for the peanut: soap, ink, oil and more. He also travelled with a wagon school to teach farmers.

caption.id: Carver mengajar selama 47 tahun dan membagikan ilmunya dengan cuma-cuma. Dari Carver, kita belajar merawat bumi dan berbagi ilmu.
caption.en: Carver taught for 47 years and gave his knowledge away freely. From Carver we learn to care for the earth and to share what we know.

title.en: Wangari Maathai and millions of trees

ST-MAATHAI.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Wangari Maathai" (born 1 April 1940, Nyeri, Kenya; PhD 1971, first woman in East or Central Africa to earn a doctorate; Green Belt Movement 1977, village women plant trees; some 30 million trees; Nobel Peace Prize 2004, first Black African woman laureate; died 25 September 2011); The Green Belt Movement, "Who we are" (women reported streams drying up and long walks for firewood; trees hold soil, store rainwater and give food and firewood).

caption.id: Wangari Maathai lahir tahun 1940 di Nyeri, Kenya, di kaki pegunungan yang hijau. Ia suka bermain di dekat sungai kecil.
caption.en: Wangari Maathai was born in 1940 in Nyeri, Kenya, at the foot of green mountains. She loved playing by a little stream.

caption.id: Ia belajar biologi sampai ke Amerika dan Jerman. Tahun 1971, ia menjadi perempuan pertama di Afrika Timur yang meraih gelar doktor.
caption.en: She studied biology as far as America and Germany. In 1971 she became the first woman in East Africa to earn a doctorate.

caption.id: Para ibu di desa bercerita: sungai mengering, kayu bakar makin jauh, dan tanah terbawa hujan karena pohon-pohon ditebang.
caption.en: Village mothers told her: the streams were drying up, firewood was farther away and the soil washed away in the rain, because the trees had been cut down.

caption.id: Tahun 1977, ia memulai Gerakan Sabuk Hijau. Para ibu menyemai bibit dan menanam pohon di sekitar desa mereka.
caption.en: In 1977 she started the Green Belt Movement. Mothers grew seedlings and planted trees around their villages.

caption.id: Puluhan juta pohon tumbuh. Tahun 2004, ia meraih Hadiah Nobel Perdamaian, perempuan Afrika pertama yang menerimanya.
caption.en: Tens of millions of trees grew. In 2004 she won the Nobel Peace Prize, the first African woman to receive it.

caption.id: Dari Wangari, kita belajar bahwa hal kecil seperti menanam satu pohon bisa mengubah dunia.
caption.en: From Wangari we learn that a small act, like planting one tree, can change the world.

ST-MANDELA.source: Nelson Mandela Foundation, "Biography of Nelson Mandela" (learners' biography: born 18 July 1918, Mvezo; named Rolihlahla, 'Nelson' from his teacher; arrested 1962, 18 years on Robben Island, studied law in prison; released 11 February 1990; Nobel Peace Prize 1993 with F.W. de Klerk; voted 27 April 1994, inaugurated 10 May 1994; died 5 December 2013); NobelPrize.org, "Nelson Mandela - Speed read" (27 years in prison; apartheid as racial segregation; reconciliation); UN General Assembly 2009: Nelson Mandela International Day, 18 July (67 minutes of service).

caption.id: Nelson Mandela lahir tahun 1918 di desa Mvezo, Afrika Selatan. Nama kecilnya Rolihlahla; nama Nelson diberikan gurunya di sekolah.
caption.en: Nelson Mandela was born in 1918 in the village of Mvezo, South Africa. His childhood name was Rolihlahla; his teacher gave him the name Nelson at school.

caption.id: Saat itu, hukum apartheid memisahkan orang menurut warna kulit. Orang kulit hitam tidak boleh memilih dan dilarang masuk banyak tempat.
caption.en: In those days, apartheid laws separated people by the colour of their skin. Black people could not vote and were kept out of many places.

caption.id: Mandela, seorang pengacara, menuntut agar semua orang setara. Karena itu ia dipenjara 27 tahun, sebagian besar di Pulau Robben.
caption.en: Mandela, a lawyer, demanded that everyone be treated as equals. For that he was imprisoned for 27 years, mostly on Robben Island.

caption.id: Di penjara, ia terus belajar dan membaca. Pada 11 Februari 1990, ia akhirnya bebas, disambut ribuan orang.
caption.en: In prison he kept studying and reading. On 11 February 1990 he was finally free, welcomed by thousands of people.

caption.id: Ia tidak membalas dendam. Ia berjabat tangan dengan lawannya, dan bersama Presiden de Klerk meraih Hadiah Nobel Perdamaian 1993.
caption.en: He did not seek revenge. He shook hands with his opponents, and with President de Klerk he won the 1993 Nobel Peace Prize.

caption.id: Tahun 1994, semua warga boleh memilih untuk pertama kalinya, dan Mandela menjadi presiden. Setiap 18 Juli, dunia memperingati Hari Mandela dengan berbuat baik.
caption.en: In 1994 every citizen could vote for the first time, and Mandela became president. Every 18 July, the world marks Mandela Day by doing good deeds.

model_answer.en: A tree! Wangari Maathai got mothers to plant millions of trees.
